// Distant Lands | 2026
// Converts global shader properties to IDs to be used at runtime
// All global variables are structured in this format: CZY_[Category]_[Feature]_[Property]
// Generated by VariableStack for COZY


using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;
using System;
using static DistantLands.Cozy.CozyUtilities;
using static DistantLands.Cozy.AtmosphereFactory;

namespace DistantLands.Cozy
{
    [Serializable]
    public class AtmosphereModel
    {
/*__VARIABLES__*/

        public void Reset() 
        {
            DefaultAtmosphereReferences defaultReferences = Resources.Load<DefaultAtmosphereReferences>("Default COZY Atmosphere References");
            
/*__RESET_FUNCTION__*/
        }

        public void UpdateModel(CozyAtmosphereModule module)
        {
            if (!module) return;

            if (module.AtmosphereProfile) {
                AtmosphereProfile profile = module.AtmosphereProfile;
                AtmospherePresetParameters preset = profile.presetParameters;

/*__UPDATE_FUNCTION__*/

                foreach (AtmosphereOverride atmosphereOverride in profile.overrides)
                {
                    if (atmosphereOverride == null) continue;
                    atmosphereOverride.ApplyToModel(this);
                }
            }

            foreach (AtmosphereOverride atmosphereOverride in module.overrides)
            {
                if (atmosphereOverride == null) continue;
                atmosphereOverride.ApplyToModel(this);
            }
        }

        public void UpdateModel(AtmosphereProfile profile)
        {
            if (!profile) return;

            AtmospherePresetParameters preset = profile.presetParameters;

/*__UPDATE_BY_PROFILE_FUNCTION__*/

            foreach (AtmosphereOverride atmosphereOverride in profile.overrides)
            {
                if (atmosphereOverride == null) continue;
                atmosphereOverride.ApplyToModel(this);
            }
        }

        public void ApplyToParameters(AtmosphereParameters parameters, float time, float weight = 1f)
        {
            if (weight == 0) return;
            if (weight == 1) 
            {
/*__APPLY_FUNCTION_WEIGHT_1__*/
                return;
            }

/*__APPLY_FUNCTION__*/
        }
    }
}
